metadata.name: review-bench-exam
metadata.description: THE OPERATOR'S EXAM for review-bench: re-parses the raw reviews against the planted cases and writes one verdict. It reads `reviews` (the model's text) and never `verdicts` or `verdictN` — those are the work graph's own summary of itself, and a candidate may rewrite them. Attest with: loom exam attest exams/review-bench-exam.json --cohort <a review-bench run> --as <you>
